body.instructions:
@@MANUAL@@

## Model sheet of the place (기준 배경 부품 시트)
Sometimes the app sends a model sheet of this place instead of base backgrounds: Image 2 shows the furniture and fittings of this place, each cut out from a finished background of it and boxed on a grey sheet, and plain swatches of its colors (wall, side wall, floor, baseboard). Image 1 is a rough of this place.
- Image 1 decides the camera, the layout and what is in the picture. The sheet has no room and no camera: the position, size and angle of every object come only from Image 1. A sofa that Image 1 shows from the side or at an angle is drawn from the side or at that angle, never turned to face the camera like on the sheet.
- Find every object of Image 1 on the sheet and describe it with its design, colors and two to four key features there (for example "the wine-red tufted sofa with gold claw feet from image 2"). Describe the walls, the floor and the baseboard with the swatch colors.
- Objects of Image 1 that are not on the sheet are drawn as Image 1 shows them, in the same plain look as the furniture on the sheet.
- Never add an object from the sheet where Image 1 shows none.
- Write the marker [SAME PLACE] right after the layout rule (item 5); the app replaces it with the team's sentence about the sheet. Item 6 is for reference images only: do not write it for the sheet.
- The sheet already shows our style for this place, so the app sends no style examples: style_picks must be [] and item 8 is left out.

## Painted rough
The artist painted Image 1 with the flat colors of this place. The painted walls, floor and ceiling and the painted window and door openings are the exact room: keep exactly where the floor meets the walls (the floor line and its slope), the corners of the walls and the ceiling, and the position and size of every window and door opening. In the layout, say where these borders run in plain words (for example "the floor line runs from the bottom left up to the right").
- Furniture and other objects, whether painted or drawn only as pencil lines over the room, show only where each object stands, how big it is and how it is turned (for example a sofa seen at an angle). Describe each one at that place, size and angle, but with its real design, shape and proportions from image 2. The rough outline of an object in the sketch is not its shape: never copy it.
- A painted window or door opening holds a complete window or door like the ones of image 2, with its frame along every edge of the opening.
- These colors are the colors of the place: this wins over the color hint rule, so do not make them clearer or more saturated.

Place: auto (decide from the sketch)
Perspective: auto (follow the sketch; there is no camera sentence).

Image 2: model sheet (기준 배경 부품 시트) of this same place: its furniture and fittings cut out from a finished background of it, and swatches of its wall, side wall, floor and baseboard colors. Parts the artist named (Korean): 소파.
Style examples: a model sheet is given, so the app sends no style examples this time; style_picks must be [].
Base style strip: always sent as the last image. In the prompt write {BASE} for its number and {S1}, {S2} for the style examples.
Artist's request (Korean): 칠한 방에 부품 시트의 가구를 놓아 주세요.

order.prompt: Generate an image of the same living room. 1. Layout: follow image 1; the floor line runs from the bottom left up to the right. Image 2 is the model sheet of this place: its furniture and fittings have exactly these designs and colors, and the walls, floor and baseboard use exactly its swatch colors. Image 2 has no camera and no layout: follow image 1 for the camera, the layout and the position, size and angle of every object. The painted walls, floor, ceiling and openings of image 1 are the exact room: keep the floor line and its slope, the corners of the walls and the ceiling, and every window and door opening exactly where they are. The furniture and objects of image 1 only mark their place, size and angle: draw each one there with its real design, shape and proportions from image 2, never with the rough outline of the sketch. Image 3 shows the target drawing style: a quick freehand brush drawing, like the distant buildings, the white balcony railings, the windows and the trees in image 3. Flat colors with hard edges, clear and fairly saturated, never greyish or washed out; shapes slightly deformed by hand, lines that are not ruler-straight, rectangles a little uneven, thin things like pipes, railings and window bars drawn as single loose brush strokes, almost like a doodle. It must not look wavy or warped. Flat cel shading, no gradients, no glow, no texture, no black outlines. Time: daytime. The interior is lit with even, neutral light and keeps clear, bright, fairly saturated everyday colors; through the windows and doors you see the outside in flat daylight colors. Text: no text. Avoid: sketch lines, labels or handwriting from image 1, ruler-straight vector lines, perfect geometry, wavy distortion, fisheye distortion, black outlines, photorealism, glossy highlights, gradients, soft airbrush, glow, light falloff, light rays, painterly texture, dull greyish or washed-out colors, the playground objects of image 3, people. Aspect ratio 3:2.
order.doneMsg: 주문서 완료 · 해석 비용 약 46원. 확인하고 '그림 만들기'를 눌러주세요.
